_about.chapter: Cast and looks: every speaker's colour, who stands where in a cinematic scene, where the crew idles at home, how every named character looks, the colours looks share, the Double Nights android finishes, the wardrobe Stella can buy and wear, and the finishes and named materials it is drawn with.
_about.how_to_edit: Plain JSON, inlined by tools/build.mjs as GAME_DB.cast and checked by tools/test-game-db.cjs. Colours are '#rrggbb' (or '#rgb'). In appearances, { "palette": "<name>" } stands for that colour from palette, so a colour several looks share is changed once. Crowds (ROLE_LOOKS) and the field mask are code and stay in core/appearances.js. _about.notes keeps the explanations that were comments in the code, keyed by path.

tables.speaker_colors: Every speaker's colour, by the name shown on their line (SPEAKER_COLORS): name tags, the dialogue box, captions, the phone, speech bubbles and the cinematic subtitles.
tables.scene_cast: Who can speak in a cinematic scene (SCENE_CAST, story/scenes/cast.js), by cast id: the name on their subtitle, whose look their cameo wears (an appearances key), which side of the screen they stand on (949 left, others right), and color_of, the speaker_colors name their colour comes from when it isn't their name.
tables.apartment_idle: Where each crew member waits in the apartment (APT_IDLE_POSITIONS): x, y in the map's pixels, and pose, what they do there (ui/poses.js).
tables.palette: Colours several looks share (PALETTE): Stella's skin, curls and eyes, the house gold, the gangers' pink and maroon, the Double Nights uniforms, and the crowds' pools of skins, hair and eyes (read by ROLE_LOOKS).
tables.android_finishes: Double Nights android plating (ANDROID_FINISHES): silver, gold, bloodmoon. plate, trim and sheen colour the body, glow the eyes, coolant ('r, g, b') what they bleed.
tables.appearances: How every named character looks (APPEARANCES), by name: the humanoid config of ui/wardrobe.js (gender, build, skinColor, hair, top, bottom, shoes, train, hat, jewelry, held, body, pose) plus eyeColor (portrait irises), accent (their signature colour: car paint, the crew dot), blood (a BLOOD_KINDS name or '#hex') and faceRoom (staff: face the room when idle).
tables.cosmetics: Everything Stella can buy at Neural Systems and wear through Neu.Me (COSMETICS_REGISTRY), by id: category (wig, skin, vocal, outfit, accessory, hat, jewelry, legwear), name, desc, price, data (the humanoid config fields it sets), and default (owned from the start), crafted (made at the workbench, never sold), pairsWith, options.
tables.finishes: How each finish is drawn (materialKit rules, directory/game-materials.js); see _about.fields.finishes.
tables.materials: Named materials the wardrobe links to by `material`: [color, fabric, finish], leaving out what doesn't apply.

finishes.boot_shine: a thigh boot's shaft is drawn glossy
finishes.boot_shade: how far a thigh boot's shaft is darkened
finishes.pump_shine: a highlight on the pump's toe
finishes.surface: the boot gets a surface pass (ui/wardrobe.js bootSurface): nap or flecks
finishes.nap: velvet's soft nap (and a deeper tone in portraits)
finishes.flecks: stardust: fixed flecks with a slow glint
finishes.portrait_shine: the portrait's highlight strength on boots and shoes (null: by the shoe's shape)

notes.appearances[\"949\"]: ── Stella (949). Her cosmetics replace these; this is who she is without them ──
notes.appearances[\"747\"]: ── 747 (Seven), her brother: her mirror in the field, the mask tinged purple, eyes slits of gold ──
notes.appearances[\"Guard Unit Alpha\"]: ── Double Nights: AI staff in moon silver, sun-on-moon gold, or Blood Moon rose ──
notes.appearances[\"Chef Koda\"]: The Cozy Cafe's cook, at the range in his whites
notes.appearances[\"Chef Amara\"]: Enni Cole's chef, in her kitchen behind Cuisine upstairs
notes.appearances[\"Dr. Yin\"]: The Empereal Lord's scientist and medic; she keeps Stella and 747 running
notes.appearances.Anavia: ── The city's cast ── The VIP: periwinkle silk and gold, a glass of Bellafore red
notes.appearances[\"Ms. Jean\"]: The red dress, and her own brand in hand — Ms. Jean Cream Soda
notes.appearances.Prisma: Crystalline — a shimmer plays over her (NPC.draw)
notes.appearances.Contractor: Voices on the line (no body in the world yet)
notes.appearances.Keeper: The prologue's fireside: the Keeper of the Elements (an old seer, red robe) and her visitor
notes.appearances.Larissa: "dripped with professionalism in a white suit"
notes.cosmetics.acc_umbrella: ─── A.C.C.E.S.S.O.R.I.E.S (held items; optional slot; may have options) ───
notes.cosmetics.acc_mirror_glass: Crafted at the workbench from the Crystal Glass (story/missions.js SCHEMATICS), never sold: all her damage ×1.35, and a shield that turns enemy shots back (engine/status-effects.js MIRROR)
notes.cosmetics.outfit_masquerade: ── Evening: the special dresses (bodices and gowns; `fabric` is how the cloth catches light in her dressing room) ──
notes.cosmetics.jew_bangles: ── JEWELRY (wear as many as you like) ──
notes.cosmetics.leg_thigh_bands: ── LEGWEAR (wear any of them over any outfit). Pieces with `shoes` replace the outfit's shoes; the rest draw on the legs like jewelry (ui/wardrobe.js jewelry, at: 'thighs').
notes.apartment_idle.Victoria: pose: what they do while they're here (see ui/poses.js) Balcony — gazing out

outfit_crimson.name: Crimson Flame

outfit_amber.name: Amber Warmth

outfit_artbuilds.name: Art Builds Freedom
outfit_artbuilds.desc: Long black coat over a black hoodie. Cargo pants, white sneakers.

outfit_anavia.name: Anavia
outfit_anavia.desc: Periwinkle crop top and long skirt. Gold heels. Pairs with bangles and a headband.

outfit_runner.name: Night Runner

outfit_sorcerer.name: Street Sorcerer

outfit_moonlit_satin.desc: A champagne satin slip dress, bias-cut to mid-calf. Gold heels. Pairs with a Crystal Glass.
